claims: Paul Thomas Anderson won the Best Director Oscar for the film One Battle After Another at the 98th Academy Awards on March 15, 2026.
Paul Thomas Anderson's Best Director Oscar win marked his first Oscar win.
One Battle After Another is a loose adaptation of Thomas Pynchon’s Vineland.
One Battle After Another stars Leonardo DiCaprio.
Paul Thomas Anderson was the Best Director winner for One Battle After Another at the 2026 Academy Awards.
Ryan Coogler was a nominee for Best Director for Sinners at the 2026 Academy Awards.
Josh Safdie was a nominee for Best Director for Marty Supreme at the 2026 Academy Awards.
Joachim Trier was a nominee for Best Director for Sentimental Value at the 2026 Academy Awards.
Chloé Zhao was a nominee for Best Director for Hamnet at the 2026 Academy Awards.
Paul Thomas Anderson had 11 previous nominations before his Best Director Oscar win.
Paul Thomas Anderson's Best Director Oscar win was his first competitive Oscar win.
One Battle After Another won six awards in total at the 2026 Academy Awards ceremony.
Ryan Coogler won best original screenplay for Sinners.
Paul Thomas Anderson won adapted screenplay.
